en.title: Neuralink Valuation Drops on AI Security Fears
en.summary: Neuralink's probability of reaching $100B by year-end dropped 6.5% to 15%, primarily driven by China's warning on security risks in Anthropic’s AI tool. This event dampened market confidence for high-valuation AI and deep tech companies.
drivers: China warns of security risks in Anthropic AI.
Dampened market confidence for deep tech valuations.
Increased regulatory scrutiny concerns for AI/BCI.
en.why_matters: This movement highlights the increasing geopolitical and regulatory risks faced by advanced AI and deep tech firms. Investor sentiment can quickly shift based on international security concerns, impacting ambitious valuation targets.
en.bull_case: Strong US venture funding and continued investor appetite for ambitious tech could propel Neuralink's valuation.
en.bear_case: Geopolitical security warnings and regulatory scrutiny on AI/BCI technology could hinder Neuralink's path to $100B.

zh.title: AI安全担忧拖累Neuralink估值
zh.summary: Neuralink年底估值达1000亿美元的可能性下降6.5%至15%，主要受中国对Anthropic AI工具安全风险警告的影响。此事件打击了市场对高估值AI和深度科技公司的信心。
drivers: 中国警告Anthropic AI安全风险。
市场对深度科技估值信心受挫。
AI/脑机接口技术监管担忧加剧。
zh.why_matters: 此波动凸显了先进AI和深度科技公司面临日益增长的地缘政治和监管风险。投资者情绪可能因国际安全担忧而迅速转变，影响雄心勃勃的估值目标。
zh.bull_case: 美国强劲的风险投资和对雄心勃勃科技的持续兴趣可能推动Neuralink估值。
zh.bear_case: 地缘政治安全警告和对AI/BCI技术的监管审查可能阻碍Neuralink达到1000亿美元。
